nodes.label: AI Export News-Driver Analysis Decision
nodes.description: Decision adding portfolio.market_events_review as analysis 17: matches deterministic LibreFolio portfolio evidence with LLM-side external news research, separating observed movement evidence from causal claims.

nodes.label: portfolio.market_events_review Analysis
nodes.description: Portfolio analysis requiring portfolio.overview and portfolio.asset_comparison; optionally includes portfolio.performance_flows; LLM identifies observed movements and exact date windows before researching; separates issuer, sector/industry, and macro drivers; labels each link supported/inferred/speculative.

nodes.label: LLM-Side Web Research Pattern
nodes.description: Rationale: external news fetching, source selection, and citation remain an LLM-side task; backend supplies deterministic versioned portfolio evidence only and never fetches or selects news; LLM falls back to a deterministic movement inventory when web access is unavailable, without fabricating citations.

nodes.label: Causality Boundary for News-Movement Links
nodes.description: Constraint: LLM must provide publisher, title, URL, publication date, access date, and source type for each citation; label links supported/inferred/speculative; include conflicting evidence; explicitly list unexplained movements; never claim timing alone proves causation.
